EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 473 August 12, 1976
MAKING THE SOLICITOR GENERAL A MEMBER OF THE CABINET
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby order that the Solicitor General shall be a member of the Cabinet with all the rights, honors and
privileges pertaining to the position.
This Executive Order supersedes Executive Order No. 454.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
